title: Mix, Mingle, and Map the Common Fund Data Ecosystem at ASHG 2025!
bodyHtml:
Join us Tuesday, October 14th from 7-9 PM ET at the The Westin Boston Seaport District | Grand C-D.

This networking and engagement event will bring together consortium members, researchers, awardees, and interns for an evening of connection, knowledge-sharing, and future planning. The event will include lightning talks, poster presentations, demos, and opportunities to learn about funding pathways. Each attendee will receive two drink tickets upon registration and appetizers will be served.

Posters are available to anyone, you submit a 250 word abstract. Posters should highlight scientific results, CFDE projects, tools, etc. Those who are interested in being considered for a 5-minute lightning talk should check off yes on the form. The planning committee will then select 3 poster submitters to feature. Poster judges will evaluate presentations, with potential awards given based on agreed criteria.

This event is designed to highlight scientific achievements, foster networking, and showcase innovations within the consortium. Attendees will leave with new connections, insights into ongoing work, and awareness of future opportunities for collaboration and funding.

Register here -- this is first come, first serve.
